correctness.rationale: The sharp coordinate-only max from Ivanov 2026 makes graph neighborhoods exhaustive near the endpoint. The exact projected-hull formula reduces locally to the inverse-square-root Gram determinant. Gaussian QR yields an independent-beta product for the coordinate determinant; a rigorous Haar graph-density Taylor integral yields C_{n,k} and the second coefficient m(k-2)(q-2)/(4(m+2)), including the zero-correction cases. Orthogonal graph complement and Sylvester determinant identity prove eventwise near-endpoint duality. Included checker verified 1400 independent convex-hull area comparisons, 198 moment formulas, 105 coefficient identities and a seeded beta Monte Carlo sanity check. Experiments are corroboration, not infinite proofs.
